tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen (Adobe Spectrum's dark background-base). Neutral, untinted gray so the user's colors aren't shifted.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Behind the video or photo preview inside both editors, as in CapCut, so the frame edges read clearly.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, bottom navigation, tool bar, timeline lanes (Spectrum layer-1).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised controls on surface: secondary buttons, chips, search field, selected segment, empty media frames.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers and quiet borders. Decorative only: never the only sign of a control's edge.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons (about 95% white, softer than pure white on near-black). 12.4:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text and inactive icons. 5.7:1 or more on canvas, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, placeholders, timecodes and ruler labels. 4.6:1 or more on canvas, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Memix sky blue: CapCut's cyan moved 9° toward Spectrum blue. The one primary action per screen (Create, Export, Apply), the active tool, links, progress, and everything that is a meme sound. Text on it is on-primary (7.9:1).

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of primary fills. Text on it is on-primary (6.0:1).

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: 16% sky wash behind the active tool, the playing sound row and sound play buttons. Icons on it use primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, primary-pressed, selection-white fills and danger. Also the 1px dark edge beside white selection marks drawn over the user's content (the text frame, its handle and snap guides on the preview, P1-10), so they read on any video: white plus this edge is at least 4.3:1 against any color.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected clip or layer outline, trim handles, playhead, selected chip fill: white, as in CapCut, so selection never competes with clip colors.

tokens.name: track-video
tokens.usage: Main video and overlay clips (they show thumbnails). Labels on it are text.

tokens.name: track-text
tokens.usage: Text clips on the timeline and text layers in the layers panel. Labels on it are on-track (7.5:1).

tokens.name: track-sticker
tokens.usage: Sticker, image and cut-out clips. Labels on it are on-track (9.0:1).

tokens.name: track-meme-sound
tokens.usage: Meme sound clips: the brand color, same as primary, so sound is always Memix blue. Labels on it are on-track (7.9:1).

tokens.name: track-audio
tokens.usage: Original audio, imported audio and voiceover clips: green, the editing convention for audio. Labels on it are on-track (6.8:1).

tokens.name: track-effect
tokens.usage: Effect and filter clips. Labels on it are on-track (6.5:1).

tokens.name: on-track
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on every colored track fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete, discard and recording states, always with a word or icon. Text on it is on-primary (5.7:1).

tokens.name: danger-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of danger fills. Text on it is on-primary (4.8:1).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Export finished and saved states, always with a word or icon. Text on it is on-primary (9.3:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch-access focus: a solid 2px ring, 2px outside the control.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

fonts.note: Hindi display face (P1-17) and the Devanagari partner of Anton in captions (P1-10). Alternative: the variable https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/teko/Teko%5Bwght%5D.ttf (285 KB, weights 300 to 700), only if Compose Multiplatform resources can set its weight axis on Android and iOS.
Caption font 'Modern' (P1-10). Indian Type Foundry; Latin, Latin Ext, Devanagari.
Caption font 'Bubbly' (P1-10). Ek Type; Latin, Latin Ext, Vietnamese, Devanagari. Static build from the upstream that google/fonts names (its own file is the 667 KB variable Baloo2[wght].ttf).
Caption font 'Handwritten' (P1-10). Indian Type Foundry; Latin, Latin Ext, Devanagari.
Caption font 'Serif' (P1-10). Indian Type Foundry; Latin, Latin Ext, Devanagari.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Anton, Google Fonts (SIL OFL). Meme captions, the wordmark and the Home hero only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero and empty-state headlines, uppercase.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Entry cards and sheet heroes, uppercase.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The Memix name (Home top bar, until a logo exists). Always Anton, in every language: unlike display, it never switches to the Hindi face. Written as is, not uppercased.

styles.name: meme-caption
styles.usage: Default caption style in both editors: white fill with a 3px black outline stroke (the classic meme look; this is the user's content, not chrome).

groups.name: Display (Hindi)
groups.note: Teko Bold, Indian Type Foundry (SIL OFL 1.1): Latin, Latin Extended and Devanagari. Replaces the Display group's display-xl and display when the app language is Hindi (P1-17), for the whole string, Latin letters included. The Memix wordmark stays Anton. Letter spacing 0, because tracking breaks the Devanagari headline bar.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hindi: Home hero and empty-state headlines. Line height 1.3x leaves room for marks above the headline bar and below the baseline.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hindi: entry cards and sheet heroes.

groups.name: Caption sample
groups.note: Set in the caption font it previews (caption.fonts), at that file's own weight. The only interface text not in Space Grotesk, Space Mono or the display faces, because the sample is the choice.

styles.name: caption-sample
styles.usage: The name on each FontTile in the Style panel (P1-10), drawn in that font. Line height 28 leaves room for Devanagari marks above and below in every caption font.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Space Grotesk, Google Fonts (SIL OFL). Sentence case everywhere.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick a clip, drop a sound, share it.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tool bar labels, metadata, timeline clip labels.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Playback timecode, ruler marks, durations in the editors.

spacing.note: 4px base. Screen side gutter is space-4.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, gaps between clips on a track.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows and chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter, card and sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding, tab gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above screen titles, large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

radius.note: Chunky, never sharp; pills for chips and tabs.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Timeline clips, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the Create button, tool highlights.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, template thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented tabs, play buttons.

shadow.note: No hard or decorative shadows: surfaces separate by value steps (canvas → surface → surface-raised), as in CapCut and Spectrum. Only sheets and floating menus cast a soft shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets lifting over a screen.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating menus and toasts.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and quiet borders, with the hairline color.

tokens.name: stroke-selection
tokens.usage: Selected clip or layer outline, with the selection color.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, offset 2px.

size.note: Fixed sizes used across screens (dp on Android).

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum tappable size for every control.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation bar.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Editor tool bar.

tokens.name: track-height-video
tokens.usage: Main video track clips.

tokens.name: track-height
tokens.usage: Every other track's clips.

tokens.name: playhead-width
tokens.usage: Timeline playhead line, in selection white.

tokens.name: playhead-head-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the round head on top of the timeline playhead, in selection white, centered on the line at the top of the ruler.

tokens.name: trim-handle-width
tokens.usage: Width of the white trim handles at both ends of the selected timeline item, just outside its selection outline. The touch target around each handle is still touch-target wide.

tokens.name: icon-small
tokens.usage: Icons inside timeline items and badges, where a 24px icon doesn't fit (for example the lock on a locked item). The same drawings as the 24px set, scaled down; never for standalone controls.

tokens.name: rail-height
tokens.usage: The thin rail under a fill: progress bar and slider. Rail in hairline, fill in primary. Called rail, not track, because a track is a timeline lane in Memix.

tokens.name: canvas-handle-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the white scale-and-rotate handle on a selected text (later stickers and layers) on the preview, with a 1px on-primary edge and an icon-small icon in on-primary. Its touch target is still touch-target (P1-10).

tokens.name: swatch-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of a color swatch (text and outline colors, later brush colors). Drawn inside a touch-target square; the selected ring sits 2px outside it (P1-10).

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Presses, toggles, nav item color changes, and the reduce-motion fade that replaces every movement.

tokens.name: duration-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets sliding in and out, tab content changes.

tokens.name: duration-screen
tokens.usage: Screen pushes and pops.

tokens.name: duration-bonk
tokens.usage: The bonk: content landing on the timeline scales 1 to 1.12 to 1 with a slight overshoot. Only for placing content.

caption.note: User content, not chrome: how captions (TextItem, TextLayer) render in both editors and in export. Never read through MemixTheme; the engineer keeps these in one commonMain place shared by the engines and both editors. Values are part of every saved draft's look: changing one after P1 ships needs a schema bump and a compensating migration. Spec: docs/ux/specs/P1-10-text.md.

fonts.name: Classic
fonts.usage: The Impact meme look and the default. Devanagari characters are drawn in Teko Bold (whole clusters, never split); emoji and other scripts in the system font.

defaults.usage: A new text uses the last style picked in the current editor visit, otherwise these.

geometry.usage: Laid out once in canvas pixels, then drawn scaled. Outline stroke = font size / 12, centered on the outline, drawn before the fill.
